Remark
[Ricci models] Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0030 1. Remark 4.2\group section-4

For a Ricci model with metric $dr^2+f^2(r)g$, where $f(r)\sim r-Kr^3/6+\cdots $, one has \[ \Ric _{M^n}\geq -(n-1)f''(r)/f(r). \] Remark 13 then holds with $V_r^H$ replaced by $f^{n-1}(r)$.

We next consider the refined injectivity angle $\wtomega (H,\epsilon ,r,x)$ under the assumptions of Proposition 5.
